The {{PAGENAME}} is received from [[Dig]]. Upon speaking with Dig, he'll ask you to get him some [[booze]]. You can either make some or speak to [[Snake]] to get some. Give the booze to Dig and he'll check it for quality by lighting it on fire and then give you the {{PAGENAME}}.
